example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ছাই কপালে, যা করুক না কেন সব উল্টো হয়ে যায়।
এই ছাই কপালের জন্য আমার স্বপ্নগুলো সব ভেঙে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: He has ash on his forehead; whatever he does turns out wrong.
Because of this ill-fated ash on my forehead, all my dreams have shattered.
history: The idiom originates from the traditional Bengali custom of applying ash to the forehead as a mark of mourning, sorrow, or impending doom, symbolizing inescapable bad luck.
note: The expression evokes a sense of inevitable misfortune rooted in cultural symbolism.
